create_Checkpointing: create a Checkpointing instance with a function and batch to enable activation checkpointing
call_checkpoint_method: call the checkpoint method on a Checkpointing object to apply Checkpoint autograd function to a batch
call_recompute_method: call the recompute method on a Checkpointing object to apply Recompute autograd function to a batch
use_is_checkpointing: use is_checkpointing to check if the current forward pass is under activation checkpointing
use_is_recomputing: use is_recomputing to check if the current forward pass is under checkpoint recomputation
